descriptionFull: The black-billed magpie ( Pica hudsonia ), also known as the American magpie , is a bird in the crow family that inhabits the western half of North America, from Colorado, to southern coastal Alaska to northern California, northern Nevada, northern Arizona, northern New Mexico, central Kansas, and Nebraska.
